from pathlib import Path
import json
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full separator rows and columns divide the canvas into matching panels.
    sep = next(v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if all(v == x for x in grid[0]) and False) if False else None
    # ARC separators are the color appearing uniformly across at least one full row and column.
    colors = set(sum(grid, []))
    sep = next(c for c in colors if any(all(x == c for x in row) for row in grid)
               and any(all(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) for j in range(w)))
    row_bounds = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    col_bounds = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[r][j] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rows = []
    start = 0
    for r in row_bounds + [h]:
        if start < r: rows.append((start, r))
        start = r + 1
    cols = []
    start = 0
    for c in col_bounds + [w]:
        if start < c: cols.append((start, c))
        start = c + 1
    bg = next(c for c in colors if c != sep and sum(x == c for row in grid for x in row) > 0)
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1) for r0, r1 in rows for c0, c1 in cols]
    src = next((p for p in panels if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(p[0],p[1]) for c in range(p[2],p[3]))), None)
    if src is None: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = src
    motif = [grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0,r1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,d,e in panels:
        for i in range(b-a):
            for j in range(e-d): out[a+i][d+j] = motif[i][j]
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-6fc09535.py'; p.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),ns)

print('demo reproduces:',ns['transform'](demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[1,1,1,4,1,1,1,4,1,1,1] for _ in range(17)]
